items.lite: Best for beginners and first-time exploration. Ideal for first-time users exploring OpenClaw capabilities, including web operations, file processing, data analysis, scheduled tasks, and more.
items.standard: Great value for daily use. Suitable for daily office work and lightweight development with OpenClaw, including batch file processing, demo creation, automated workflows, and more.
items.pro: High-f Designed for frequent AI development,with a token quota three times higher than the Standard plan. Ideal for developers and productivity-focused users who rely on AI heavily every day, supporting parallel work across multiple repositories, complex logic generation, code refactoring, agent orchestration, and more.
items.max: The preferred choice for intensive AI develoopment,with expanded quota support. Built for power users who use AI as a core productivity tool, supporting full-stack AI generation, multi-agent collaboration, CI automation, and more.
